description: This file defines a class EvictingConnectionLogger, which implements the ConnectionLogger interface. It provides logging functionality with fixed capacity for success and failure logs, evicting older logs when capacity is exceeded. The class supports logging messages, failures, exceptions, and retrieving logged entries, with optional inclusion of message headers and payloads. It also includes a builder for configuring instances.

classes.name: EvictingConnectionLogger
classes.description: Implements a logger that stores success and failure log entries up to a fixed capacity, evicting old logs when full. Supports logging success, failure, exceptions, and retrieving logs.

classes.name: EvictingConnectionLogger.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for configuring and creating instances of EvictingConnectionLogger with custom capacities, messages, and options.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Logs a success message using the provided info provider and default or specified message.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Logs a failure message, with optional exception, using the info provider.

methods.name: exception
methods.description: Logs an exception event, with optional message.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all stored success and failure logs.

methods.name: getLogs
methods.description: Retrieves all stored logs, both success and failure.

methods.name: formatMessage
methods.description: Formats messages with arguments if provided.
